tools.name: query_docs_filesystem_reducto
tools.description: Run a read-only shell command against an in-memory filesystem rooted at / that holds only the Reducto documentation pages you can read, one Markdown file per page. A page at the URL path /some/page is the file /some/page.md (the home page is /index.md). Nothing runs on a real machine and there is no network. Supported: rg, grep, find, tree, ls, cat, head, tail, wc, sort, uniq, cut, sed, awk, jq, pipes and &&. Each call is stateless and starts in /. Output is cut at 30KB. Examples: `tree / -L 2`, `rg -il "chunking" /`, `head -80 /quickstart.md`. To cite a page, drop the .md extension.

tools.name: search_reducto
tools.description: Search the Reducto documentation for guides, API references and code examples. Returns the best-matching page sections with their URLs. Use it first for broad or conceptual questions.

version.description: Accepted for compatibility; this site has one version.

tools.name: submit_feedback
tools.description: Report a problem with a documentation page (incorrect, outdated, confusing, incomplete, or a broken example) so the docs team can fix it. Not for product support.

path.description: URL path of the page, e.g. /quickstart.
